sentences.text: Hmph. I have reviewed the sensor events, and the claim of a haunting is not supported by the data.
Between 05:40 and 06:00, the appliance energy in the house reached 270 Wh, which is significantly above the expected 60 Wh.
This large increase in consumption, which is labeled as "the machines waking up", suggests a physical cause rather than a spectral one.
I probably conclude that the high energy usage was simply normal morning activity, not any kind of disturbance.
